title: Nexus OS Personal Local Stack v1 declaration / lock file (v1alpha2)
description: The single machine-readable SOURCE OF TRUTH for a Nexus OS Personal instance. TARGET-STATE deployment contract — it describes the ONE opinionated local stack a Personal instance runs; it is NOT an executable installer and does not assert that a pullable container image exists. Personal v1 does not ask the owner to evaluate or choose architecture, infrastructure providers, databases, deployment modalities or optional topology: those are Hub-subscription capabilities and are pinned false in `spec.boundaries`. The only first-run LLM setup is an Anthropic and/or OpenAI connector token, supplied BY REFERENCE (see secret-bundle-ref). This document carries NO secret values.

stack_id.description: Fixed stack identity. Personal v1 has exactly ONE predefined local stack; the id is pinned so an instance cannot silently declare a different topology.

blueprint_version.description: Blueprint version this lock was derived from (traceability).

runtime_version.description: Runtime version constraint pinned for this stack.

edition.description: Always personal. The stack is the free single-owner edition.

modality.description: Always self_hosted. Local deployment if hardware permits.

operator.description: Hub Operator (the remote Hub control channel / enrollment agent) is ABSENT. This is distinct from the in-process `reconciliation_operator` component that the single `runtime` service embeds (see spec.runtime.components): Personal reconciles desired vs actual state locally, with no Hub control plane.

hub.description: Personal has NO Hub dependency at any point.

data_region.description: Data never leaves the local instance.

orchestration.description: Single Docker Compose project. `docker compose up` stays the canonical base path.

service.description: The single Compose service running the Nexus OS Runtime/Platform.

components.description: The ONE `runtime` process embeds exactly these three in-process components: the API, the local reconciliation operator (desired-vs-actual state, no Hub control channel), and the embedded Console. Personal never splits these into separate services.

image.description: Container image coordinate. TARGET-STATE: this contract does NOT assert a pullable image exists; `resolved:false` marks a placeholder whose concrete digest is bound at release time.

repository.description: Image repository (no fake pullable reference is implied).

pin_policy.description: v1 policy pins by immutable digest at release.

digest.description: Immutable digest; present ONLY when a real release image exists.

resolved.description: false = TARGET-STATE placeholder (docs/contract only), no pullable image yet.

ports.description: Exactly one published port: the loopback HTTP listener bound to 127.0.0.1:8787.

voice_sidecar.description: Optional local voice sidecar (Voicebox, Spec M). NOT started by default; absence degrades only voice.

engine.description: Embedded SQLite. No Postgres/pgvector/qdrant/chroma in the default Personal stack.

db_path.description: Fixed absolute path of the embedded SQLite database file on the local volume.

blobs.description: Blobs/exports/artifacts on a local filesystem volume. No S3/MinIO in the default stack.

path.description: Fixed absolute path of the local artifact store.

inbound_public.description: No public inbound listener in the default stack.

tls.description: TLS on the local listener; optional on loopback.

llm.description: First-run LLM connectors. At least one of anthropic/openai MUST be configured; both MAY be. No other provider is part of the default Personal bootstrap. Keys are supplied BY REFERENCE only. Routing is deterministic (anthropic then openai), each provider request is tried exactly once and then retried exactly once on failure, and there is NO fallback to a different provider after that.

providers.description: Configured connectors. minItems 1 enforces the one-or-both rule; the item enum forbids any provider other than anthropic/openai. A provider MUST NOT appear twice (enforced additionally by the harness).

secret_ref.description: NAME of the secret (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY). Never a value; resolved from the encrypted bundle / local vault.

priority.description: Deterministic global provider preference order: anthropic then openai. The runtime selects the highest-priority CONFIGURED provider. ROUTING priority only — no model SKU, plan or purchasing is hardcoded.

retry.description: Retry policy for a single provider request.

max_retries.description: Exactly one retry: one initial attempt plus one retry of the SAME provider on failure, then give up.

backoff.description: Optional backoff strategy for the single retry.

provider_fallback.description: No fallback to a DIFFERENT provider after the selected provider's request (and its one retry) fails. The request fails; the runtime does not switch providers.

scheme.description: age/X25519 envelope encryption for the import bundle (ADR-0005).

vault.description: Secrets live in the Runtime local vault after import.

requires_hub_account.description: public/community packs install with NO Hub account or entitlement.

hardware.description: Advisory hardware profiles. Local deployment proceeds if the minimum is met.

boundaries.description: Personal prohibitions, pinned false by construction. Each of these is a Hub-subscription capability, never Personal (Spec N / ADR-0012).

cloud_provider_selection.description: Personal never selects a cloud/BYOC/managed provider.

deployment_modality_choice.description: No modality choice at bootstrap; always self_hosted local.

non_default_provider.description: No LLM provider beyond Anthropic/OpenAI in the default bootstrap.

gpu.description: GPU is NOT required: the default stack uses hosted Anthropic/OpenAI inference.
